title: bursera subtrifoliata
intro: Bursera subtrifoliata, commonly known as 'Palo de Aguila', is a plant species in the Burseraceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Bursera subtrifoliata include its potential in treating fever, digestive issues, and infections due to its antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which may help in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Bursera subtrifoliata include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
